attributes.probed_form: ITEM 1, savedregs --per-web: live ranges paired by ALIGNED POSITION with register-free roles (self-references masked to `%`), in three phases - same register AND same role (unwindowed) -> `in place`; same role, any register, within 24 aligned rows -> PERMUTED / ESCAPED (to a volatile) / INTRUDER (ours over-promoted); leftovers -> DIFFERENT ROLE or UNPAIRED. `mt*` added to NON_DEFINING (mtctr's first operand is a SOURCE). ITEM 2, wf_word_diff: `--range 0xA:0xB` over TARGET byte offsets, half-open, refusing a malformed window rather than ignoring it; exit 0 on a successful measurement. ITEM 3, probe: `--bank NAME` / `--restore NAME` / `--list-banks`, the restore taking the ordinary --revert path so the stale-restore guard, transient-pin restore, pin-drift warning and re-score all apply unchanged. ITEM 4, Gate I: three masks (record-id spans, stmw/lmw save-run bases, the existing range spelling) and the anchor requirement demoted from blocking to advisory. ITEM 5, probe replan_hint: the prescription made class-conditional on the slot arbiter's own signal, computed once and reused for the map. ITEM 6, tools/gdl/aritycheck.py: definitions, declarations, call sites and per-parameter body reads from the source tree, verdicts PHANTOM-CANDIDATE / KNR-SHORT-CALL / UNREAD-TRAILING. ITEM 7, defake_gate roster: a SLOT column from two fndiff.parse calls per unit (save-set, frame size, exclusive slots). ITEM 8, the refutation plus five regression tests carrying CT's tree shape. ITEM 9, AGENTS.md: --at-head and the dtk lbl_-run prefix rule.

attributes.verification: ITEM 1 REPRODUCED at HEAD before any edit: `savedregs game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D8BCC --per-web` printed FIVE `DIFFERENT ROLE` rows, four of which paired unrelated live ranges - the target's `@0x1d8 add r19,r12,r0` against our `@0x1c4 li r19,0`. `fnasm 0x1c0:0x260 --diff` shows the truth: target's r21 range IS our r19 range at the same offsets with an identical role. CALIBRATED over 54 units / 267 nonmatching functions with both objects on disk: the ordinal view flags 3187 later rows in 176 functions; lifetime pairing reclassifies 1869 of them, finds an ESCAPE or INTRUSION - a class the ordinal view cannot express - in 146 functions, and names a moved range in 20 functions the ordinal view called clean. WINDOW SWEPT 6/12/24/48/96: `in place` is window-INVARIANT (3682 at every setting) and PERMUTED moves 4.8% across a 16x sweep, while ESCAPED (189->304) and INTRUDER (117->235) trade against UNPAIRED (1265->816), so those verdicts print their reach. `mt*` phantom definitions: 12 rows in the same corpus. ITEM 2 REPRODUCED: `wf_word_diff game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D8BCC` exited 1 on a successful measurement; --range 0x1c4:0x250 now reports 23 of 66 words (34.8%) in that window and exits 0. ITEM 3 VERIFIED END TO END on game/mb/mb_camera: --bank axis-base, an f32 x/y declaration swap inside MBCameraUpdate, then --restore axis-base printed '2 hunk(s) inside MBCameraUpdate reverted; 0 hunk(s) elsewhere' and `git status --short` reported the file clean. ITEM 4 CALIBRATED over all 1814 accepted records: 92 carry a hypothesis, 15 would trip on 33 register gaps - 29 quote the register inside a real PPC instruction and lack only an `@0x` within 140 characters, 2 are stmw save-run bases, and 2 are the genuine class, i.e. 2/33 = 6% precision on a BLOCKING gate. After the change: 2 records trip, both genuine. The stated record-id cause has ZERO live firings; 10 of 1814 ids carry a register-shaped token and 12 hypothesis statements quote an id, so it is latent, and the mask is prevention. ITEM 5 REPRODUCED from the CL record: four declaration-class probes on MBCameraUpdate's frame surplus all returned NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL at digest 92a95ba06d65 while both probes that reached codegen were statement-shape, and the banner prescribed the declaration class unconditionally. `probe game/mb/mb_camera MBCameraUpdate` confirms the slot arbiter fires there (frame target 40 vs ours 48; slots differ 4t/4o). ITEM 6: the first census read 16 KNR-SHORT-CALL rows; four measured false-positive classes came out (blanked string literals made `strncmp(sig, "VBNK", 4)` read as 2 arguments; macro bodies; varargs; definitions with no call site) and a fifth defect made the tool blind to its own control case - every one of attract.c's six sndFxInit CALL sites was filed as a declaration because it ends in a semicolon. ITEM 7 CALIBRATED over 256 units / 3032 functions: 58 of 353 open rows flagged (16.4%) as 17 save-set, 15 frame and 26 exclusive-slot-only, and ZERO closed rows flagged.
